title: Cushing´s Disease Epidemiology in Sweden
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to study since 1987 all patients diagnosed with CD in Sweden and determine their outcomes including mortality. A secondary objective is to focus on patients in remission and identify determinants of their different outcomes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients registered with Cushing's Disease in Sweden since 1987 in the statistical database for in- and out-patients, at the Swedish National Board of Health and Welfare will be included in the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* No
study_population: All adult patients with confirmed CD diagnosis in Sweden
